title: BrokerOpenOrder
description: One open order as reported by the broker (Tradier sandbox in v0). Returned by exec.broker_list_open_orders Activity to ReconciliationWorkflow.

client_order_id.description: Required even from broker — our place_order always sets it to intent_key. Mismatch here means the broker book contains an order we did not place.

state.description: Broker-native state string (e.g., 'open', 'partially_filled'). Reconciliation does not parse this; it is audit-only.
